initialExam.title: IAF Agniveer Vayu 2026
initialExam.description: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu entry for recruitment in various technical and non-technical trades. Candidates serve in the IAF for 4 years under the Agnipath scheme.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th pass with Physics and Math for technical trades; 12th pass for non-technical
initialExam.qualifications: 10+2 with relevant subjects based on trade group
initialExam.syllabus: Science Group: English, Physics, Math. Non-Science: English, Reasoning, General Awareness.
initialExam.examPattern: Online Test: 100 marks, 60 minutes. Phases: Phase I (Online Exam), Phase II (Physical, Adaptability, Medical).
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Exam → Physical Fitness Test → Adaptability Test → Medical → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Agniveer Vayu in IAF across technical and non-technical trades
initialExam.careerGrowth: Agniveer → 25% retained → Leading Aircraftman → Corporal → Sergeant → Junior Warrant Officer → Warrant Officer.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit agnipathvayu.cdac.in 2. Register 3. Apply online 4. Exam 5. Physical/Medical
initialExam.perks: Seva Nidhi: ₹11.71 lakh, Risk allowance, Medical, Canteen, Accommodation
